_comment: The account universe. These are the handles that must end up inside X Lists (see scripts/plan-lists.mjs, which shards this roster into paste-ready list rosters). School handles are read from config/fbs.tsv and do not need repeating here.

stateScouts._comment: State/regional feeders. This is where a 2029 sophomore's first offer shows up days before any national account touches it — the whole 'ahead of the services' edge lives in this block. Extend it aggressively; the cost of one more handle in a List is zero.

_note_players: Player accounts are NOT hand-listed. They are discovered by the mention graph in src/watchlist.js: any handle that appears inside a confirmed offer post and is not a known school/reporter becomes a watchlist candidate, is scored, and is surfaced by scripts/plan-lists.mjs for inclusion in the overflow Lists. That is how the system reaches players nobody has ranked yet.
